subject: assassin bug
title: This Bug Wears 20 Dead Ants on Its Back to Hide

scenes.text: This bug hunts ants, then wears their bodies as a disguise.
The ant assassin bug kills and drains an ant, then glues the empty body onto its own back.
It keeps going. Up to 20 dead ants stack up, a pile bigger than the bug itself.
Scientists tested it with jumping spiders, which have sharp eyes but a poor sense of smell.
Spiders attacked bugs without the corpse coat about ten times more often.
The disguise even worked on dead bugs. The coat of corpses is the whole trick.
